proposed_relationship: Combining solution-processable semiconductors with tandem architectures can enhance the power conversion efficiency of organic photovoltaics.
mechanism: The mechanism involves stacking two cells with complementary absorption spectra, enabled by transparent conducting oxides, to better utilize the solar spectrum. Solution-processable semiconductors can facilitate the fabrication of these tandem cells, potentially leading to improved efficiency. The interaction between the conjugated polymer donors, fullerene acceptors, and the solution-processable semiconductors can result in a more efficient energy transfer and conversion process.
constraint_released: The constraint of limited power conversion efficiency in single-cell organic photovoltaics is released by combining solution-processable semiconductors with tandem architectures.
